name: context-menu-25
description: A track list with queue actions, an add-to-playlist submenu, and a liked toggle per song.

{tracks.map((track, index) => ( {index + 1}
{track.title} {track.artist}
{liked.includes(track.title) ? ( ) : null} {track.length} Play next Add to queue Add to playlist New playlist Studio focus Motion design CGI & 3D setLiked((list) => checked ? [...list, track.title] : list.filter((t) => t !== track.title) ) } > Liked Go to artist ))}
